description: Lean /ship overlay injector. UserPromptSubmit hook: when the prompt is an interactive `/ship` invocation it emits a hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext note pointing at the bundled overlay (playbooks/ship.md) and reviewers workflow, both resolved from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. Fail-open: on a non-match, missing CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, parse error, or any exception it emits nothing and exits 0 — it never blocks or alters a prompt. gstack's ship SKILL.md stays authoritative. Trigger is `^/ship(\s|$)` only; the natural-language form is off unless SHIP_HOOK_NL=1.
